card.name: Words for dropping or going down
card.fires_on: Verbs and nearby words about something going down or being lowered, such as drop, lowered, decreases, descend and desaturation. It also fires on words that follow them, such as "as low as".

modes.label: Falling values
modes.description: Verbs of decrease or drop for temperature or a measurement, and the words that follow them.
modes.example: whose temperature can<< drop>> as low as 9.5

modes.label: Physical descent
modes.description: Verbs of lowering or descending a physical distance.
modes.example: tourists were<< lowered>> into the cavern in ore buckets with

modes.label: Clinical decrease
modes.description: Decrease or desaturation of a lab or heart measure, often followed by "below".
modes.example: for subjects with an LVEF that<< decreases>> below the lower limit of normal.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words meaning down, lower or decrease, and away from up or rise.
card.plain: It lights up on words about something dropping or going lower, and helps the model predict "down" or "lower" next.
